# dokploy_postgres (Data Source)

Look up a Dokploy postgres service by id. The database password is intentionally not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokploy_postgres" "example" {
  id = "your-postgres-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Postgres service id.

### Read-Only

- `app_name` (String) Dokploy-internal app name.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `database_name` (String) Database name.
- `database_user` (String) Database user.
- `docker_image` (String) Docker image.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment id.
- `external_port` (Number) Exposed host port, if any.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `status` (String) Service status.
